content.text: EPIC SANA Algarve is a five-star hotel above Praia da Falésia, between Albufeira and Vilamoura, and the closest course is the 9-hole [Pine Cliffs](/courses/pine-cliffs), about **7 minutes** away by car. The Vilamoura courses [Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna) and [Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium) are about 14 minutes away, and the [Old Course](/courses/vilamoura-old-course) about 17. **Last checked: November 2026.**

content.text: The nearest courses at a glance
Slope ratings are from the Portuguese Golf Federation for the back tees: the higher the number, the harder the course for an average golfer.

**[Pine Cliffs](/courses/pine-cliffs)** (9 holes, par 32, 2,227 m): Martin Hawtree's clifftop course at Olhos de Água, famous for its 6th, the Devil's Parlour. No handicap needed: players without one tee off from the red markers.
**[Balaia](/courses/balaia)** (9 holes, par 27, 984 m): a short course of par 3s, €50 to play. The resort says a handicap is required, without giving a limit.

**[Vilamoura Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna)** (par 72, 6,121 m, slope 135): flatter and more open than the pine-lined courses, with plenty of water. Vilamoura Golf has a free shared buggy offer on Laguna for new bookings made by 31 December 2026.

**[Vilamoura Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium)** (par 72, 6,176 m, slope 130): Martin Hawtree's flat course with wide fairways, the easiest Vilamoura course on slope. Laguna and Millennium share the lowest green fees in Vilamoura, from €88.

**[Vilamoura Old Course](/courses/vilamoura-old-course)** (par 73, 6,254 m, slope 136): Pennink's 1969 original and Vilamoura's most famous course, lined with umbrella pines, and its most expensive round.
**[Vilamoura Pinhal](/courses/vilamoura-pinhal)** (par 72, 6,353 m, slope 140): Frank Pennink's 1976 course through the pines, the toughest Vilamoura course on slope.
**[Vila Sol](/courses/vila-sol)** (27 holes, slope 135 to 137): Donald Steel's Pestana course just outside Vilamoura, with three nines played in pairs and a €60 twilight rate from 3.30pm.

**[Salgados](/courses/salgados)** (par 72, 6,033 m, slope 129): flat and one of the easiest courses in the Algarve to walk, on the wetlands behind Praia da Galé, but with plenty of water and exposed to the wind. Twilight rounds start at €47.
Golf at EPIC SANA Algarve

EPIC SANA's website doesn't list golf services such as a golf desk, discounts or a golf shuttle, so book tee times directly with the clubs. It does offer free indoor and outdoor parking and car rental with or without a driver, which makes the Vilamoura courses easy to reach.
After the round, there's the hotel's Sayanna spa, and Praia da Falésia is within walking distance.

**For a quick round,** Pine Cliffs is 7 minutes away and doesn't ask for a handicap.
**For value,** Laguna and Millennium start at €88. See [the cheapest golf in Vilamoura](/guide/cheapest-golf-in-vilamoura).

Getting there
EPIC SANA Algarve is about **40 minutes and 35 km from Faro Airport** by car, without traffic. See [Faro Airport to Albufeira with golf clubs](/guide/faro-airport-to-albufeira-with-golf-clubs).

What is the closest golf course to EPIC SANA Algarve?
Pine Cliffs, a 9-hole course about 7 minutes away. The closest 18-hole courses are Laguna and Millennium in Vilamoura, about 14 minutes away.
Does EPIC SANA offer golf packages?
Its website doesn't mention golf packages or golf services, so book your rounds directly with the clubs.
Do I need a handicap to play near EPIC SANA?

At the 18-hole courses, yes, usually up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. Pine Cliffs doesn't ask for one. See [do you need a handicap to play golf in the Algarve?](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve)
